purpose: Apples-to-apples evaluation of Patrick's archived baseline DOT/CSV and checkpoint with the same current metrics code, Leslie parameters, and archived scaler used for the coarse run; source artifacts were not modified.
warning: The archived MinMaxScaler was pickled with scikit-learn 1.7.1 and loaded under 1.8.0, which emitted InconsistentVersionWarning. tau_bar depends only on the saved latent map and Morse boxes; generated-sample membership and residual diagnostics also use the scaler.
